incident-bot: ALERT: api-gateway-eu observing sudden 502/504 surge — 10m error rate 24% (threshold 6%). Paging SRE Oncall (EU) :rotating_light:
SRE Oncall (EU): Ack. Jumping into logs and topology maps. Pulling up ingress fanout and backend health.
Maya Patel: Noticed a cluster of TLS errors in edge logs right before 502 spike: `tls: handshake failure: EOF` from edge->upstream. Could be connection resets or cert issues.
Rafael Ortiz: I see retries exploding in the gateway: client retries + gateway fanout -> backend overloaded. Sample edge log: ``edge-proxy[pid=2231] upstream auth-01:504 read timeout, retrying (attempt 3)``.
Izzy Park: auth service pods are Unhealthy? `kubectl get pods -n eu-auth` shows `auth-02` and `auth-03` in CrashLoopBackOff starting ~10m ago. Recent deploy?
deploy-bot: deploy eu-auth v3.1.2 -> v3.2.0 at 1769460600 by rafael_o (canary: partially passed).
SRE Oncall (EU): Good catch. Hypothesis: v3.2.0 introduced aggressive keepalive/tls renegotiation change causing upstream to drop connections under load. Immediate mitigations: 1) remove failing auth pods from LB, 2) incrementally rollback eu-auth to v3.1.2, 3) enable gateway short-circuit to fail fast for auth calls, 4) temporarily reduce frontend retry count, 5) enable cross-region proxy to us-west for non-EU-only traffic. I'll execute 1 and 2 now.
SRE Oncall (EU): Command: ``kubectl rollout undo deploy/auth -n eu-auth --to-revision=3 && kubectl scale deploy/auth -n eu-auth --replicas=4``
Maya Patel: Also adding quick iptables rule to drop stale TLS sessions on edge nodes to force new handshakes — might relieve conn pool.
Rafael Ortiz: Reducing gateway retry policy: ``gatewayctl set-retries --global 1``. This should cut amplification.
Izzy Park: During rollback, I see a backlog of inflight requests hitting the expiration window; some clients doing exponential backoff are still retrying aggressively. Setting short-term rate limit for partners: ``ratelimitctl set partner-a 200r/s partner-b 150r/s``.
Product Ops: Flagging partner-a and partner-b as impacted; opening tiles for comms. Drafting quick note.
SRE Oncall (EU): Rollback in progress. Deploy snapshots show v3.1.2 replicas coming up healthy. Edge TLS errors dropping. 5m error rate trending down from 24% -> 7%.
deploy-bot: rollback eu-auth to v3.1.2 requested by SRE Oncall (EU) at 1769466200.
Maya Patel: Observed a correlated spike in conntrack table exhaustion on edge nodes. Dropping conntrack entries and bumping net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max temporarily. Command run on edge-01: ``sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=262144``.
Rafael Ortiz: After conntrack bump + rollback + retry reduction, error rate stabilized ~2.8% across EU. Gateway 504s cleared.
Izzy Park: Starting post-rollback validation: synthetic health checks green, key partner endpoints returning 200s.
Product Ops: Customer blurb ready: "We observed elevated 5xx for EU region between 12:40–12:58 UTC due to a recent auth service deploy that caused upstream connection instability. We rolled back the deployment and applied mitigations; full service restored. We're contacting affected partners now." Can send?
Maya Patel: Send now. Also tagging infra to review conntrack limits and edge TLS keepalive defaults.
SRE Oncall (EU): Action items captured: 1) revert TLS/keepalive change in next auth deploy, 2) add deploy gating to catch conntrack/TLS regressions, 3) add automatic retry throttling on gateway when upstream error rate > 10%, 4) run chaos test with TLS renegotiation.
Rafael Ortiz: I'll own the rollout gating and the auth config change revert.
Izzy Park: Adding runbook steps for immediate conntrack bump and how to detect TLS handshake exhaustion.
Product Ops: Partners notified. Status page updated to 'resolved'.
incident-bot: Incident severity: Sev2 -> resolved at 1769466802.
